item.title: Review: Starfinder Galaxy Exploration Manual (Paizo)
item.description: The world is a big place to explore, but it’s not much compared to a whole universe. 13+, 4-7 players, 1-4 hours to set up, 4-6 hours to play

item.title: Review: Starfinder Character Operations Manual (Paizo)
item.description: Even with all of the playable races, fantastic feats, and customizable classes in Paizo’s Starfinder roleplaying game, sometimes your character idea still doesn’t exactly fit. 8+, 4-8 players, 30-60 to set up, 2-6 hours to play

item.title: Review: Starfinder Critical Hit and Critical Fumble Decks (Paizo)

item.title: Review: Starfinder Alien Archive 2 (Paizo)
